definitions.s_root: (b, d + 5b, a, bb, e, h) -- the root budget vector, because deficit starts at 4 and d* = d - deficit + 4 + 5*tok
definitions.s_level: (j, d + 5j, a, bb, e, h) -- the hardest vector the search can present at token level j
